stories.title: India win Asia Cup 2025 (28 September, Dubai)
stories.body: beat Pakistan by five wickets in the final; Tilak Varma's 69* and Kuldeep Yadav's 4/30; a record-extending ninth title, unbeaten across all seven matches.

one_liners: India win Asia Cup 2025 (28 September, Dubai) — beat Pakistan by five wickets in the final
